note: hu.wikipedia.org has a dedicated, detailed infobox article for Tokod vasúttállomás (active, MAV-operated, S74 service) and for the line running through it, Esztergom–Almásfüzitő-vasútvonal, whose infobox explicitly states 'Vonal: 4' - the real, documented, active national line through Tokod is line 4, not 268. Neither article, nor a direct search for '268-as vasútvonal Tokod', turns up any mention of a line numbered 268 at this location. Same pattern as pair:29939:306: independent verification names a different, real line instead of confirming the OSM candidate's code, which is enough to reject rather than merely leave unconfirmed.
